name: Akkad
startIntroPart1: Great Sargon of Akkad, Unifier of Mesopotamia, may your empire last for millenia. O' Great King of the Universe, unite all under your banner!
declaringWar: Let's see your people fare better under a more competent leader!
attacked: You dare to attack my great empire?!
defeated: No! My empire, My people! Destroyed by the likes of you, you barbarians!
introduction: I am the Great Sargon of Akkad! And you are?
hateNo: We are not agreeing to that!
afterPeace: Very well, all that fighting was getting boring anyway.
tradeRequest: We have a proposal for a trade.
denounced: Very Well. May your nation crumble before ours..
declaringfriendship: Would you like to be my friend?

name: The Philippines
startIntroPart1: President Ramon Magsaysay, may your nation be prosperous and independent. Your benevolance shall bring your people from rags to riches. And may you rise from your colonial past.
declaringWar: Tyrants like you do not deserve to be in rule..
defeated: You may have bested me, but my people shall rise once again long after my death..
introduction: I am Ramon Magsaysay. President of the Philippine Republic. Greetings to you and your people.

name: Mali
startIntroPart1: Mansa Musa, may your everlasting riches feed the masses. Your people shall never starve from your charity. And may God bless you and your kingdom of prosperity.
introduction: I am Mansa Musa. Sultan of Mali. And thanks to God, a very, VERY rich man! Who must you be?
